events.title: SIRENS Demo is here!
events.summary: Hi everyone! The SIRENS demo has just become part of Steam Next Fest! This is our first official opportunity to showcase the game to such a large audience, so we’d like to thank you for all the feedback you shared with us earlier. Thanks to you, we’ve been able to fix a huge number of bugs and polish the areas that needed some extra attention. In today’s game update, we’ve also added gamepad support.
